notes: Caller for the %classify_dx macro (classify_dx.sas) on 16 real ICD-10 codes sampled one-per-body-system from do_want.col, inlined as DATALINES. Mirrors the do_it pattern in test_classify_dx.sas: strip decimals, classify, derive body_system via bodsys. format, count systems. Each code lands in exactly one body system matching its do_want bs_wanted (num_systems=1 for all 16).
